note:
Tyumen's drop, measured by the agent's own code.

The case is built as the runs that solved Chelyabinsk (a996, 9c57 and cee8) had it: Kamensk-Uralskiy (2), Tyumen (48)
and Korkino (10) oriented, nothing dropped. For each criterion in agent.DROP_CRITERIA, a fresh case calls
drop_clip('48', criterion). The code measures the criterion and accepts or refuses the drop.
Then run 20261027T132419-a996 is replayed offline with agent.replay. That run dropped Tyumen without naming a
criterion. What today's code returns for its drop_clip and finalize steps is kept beside what the run recorded.
Every case is set to replaying, so no final_solution.json, report or run record is written. The script checks that no
file in events/ or out/ changed.

measured.rule: of two cameras whose planes cross under 10 deg, the one that crosses the rest more widely stays

summary: Of the 4 drop criteria, the code accepts near_parallel_pair for Tyumen.
near_parallel_pair holds: Tyumen's planes cross Kamensk-Uralskiy's at 7.5 degrees. Kamensk-Uralskiy's planes cross Korkino's at 66.3 degrees, and Tyumen's cross Korkino's at 58.9.
narrow_planes does not hold: Tyumen's planes cross Kamensk-Uralskiy's at 7.5 degrees and Korkino's at 58.9 degrees, and the criterion asks under 10 degrees with every kept camera.

raises_residuals does not hold: with Tyumen, Kamensk-Uralskiy's residual goes from 0.687 to 0.715 degrees (4.1 percent) and Korkino's residual goes from 0.824 to 0.931 degrees (13.0 percent). The code's threshold is "more than 25% and 0.1 deg on every other camera".
not_oriented does not hold: camera 48 is oriented.

Run 20261027T132419-a996 dropped Tyumen without naming a criterion. Replayed with today's code, its drop_clip (step 9) returns "missing arguments: ['criterion']", and its finalize (step 10) is refused: camera 48 is oriented but left out without an accepted drop_clip.
